thread.title: AAPL recovers $75 billion, returning to company value last seen before iPhone revenue miss disclosure

author: Michael Potuck
title: AAPL recovers $75 billion, returning to company value last seen before iPhone revenue miss disclosure
text: AAPL recovers $75 billion, returning to company value last seen before iPhone revenue miss disclosure By Michael Potuck Jan 25, 2019, 2:35 pm 296 pts A few weeks ago, Apple announced a rare revision that significantly lowered its earnings guidance for the 2018 holiday quarter. AAPL shares swiftly dropped 8% in after-hours trading on the news, and slid further the following day. However, today AAPL shares have officially bounced back to above the…
